title: ProRes-Det: Projector Restoration and Detection
description:
A camera pointed at a screen sees whatever the projector throws on it. ProRes-Det removes that projected light from the capture and then measures object detection before and after the removal, so the benefit of the restoration is reported rather than asserted.

The restoration model (a 3-level U-Net of NAFNet blocks with squeeze-excite channel attention) and the detector both sit behind small registry interfaces, so either can be replaced without touching the pipeline. Three run modes share one code path: offline over image pairs, replay of a recorded session, and a live webcam-plus-projector rig.

Sample data for three disjoint splits and all three trained checkpoints are included, so a clone runs with no arguments.
notes: This repository is MIT licensed. It additionally redistributes weights/detector_yolo11s.pt, a fine-tune of an Ultralytics YOLO11 checkpoint, under AGPL-3.0; the default configuration does not use it. See THIRD_PARTY.md in the archive for the full third-party accounting.
